title: 第15章 麒麟刺砖窑黑市第16章 劫道的请你吃粉
content_zh:

林青叹了口气，没再继续追问战事细节，只是对张顺道：“顺子哥，劳你帮我留意着，若有什么关于前线。特别是幽州那边传来的消息，无论好坏，都麻烦告知我一声。”
张顺拍了拍他的肩膀，郑重应下：“放心吧，林师弟，有消息我一定第一时间告诉你。”
踏入炼皮境后，铁线拳也臻至炉火纯青。
林青能明显感觉到自身实力的增长。
气血充盈，皮膜坚韧，拳脚之间劲力勃发，远非昔日可比。
然而，在武馆与师兄们的切磋，以及经历了码头那夜的惊险后。
他心中，始终存着一个念头。
拳脚套路，终究是明面上的功夫。
一旦被人摸清路数，或是遇到手持利刃的亡命徒，难免吃亏。
他想起了前世格斗武器中，常见的一种近战利器——指虎。
此物结构简单，却能极大增强拳击的破坏力，尤其适合铁线拳这种刚猛暴烈的拳法，戴在手上亦不显眼，关键时刻能起到出其不意的效果。
但在这大顺朝，凡铁匠铺锻造刀剑等制式兵器，皆需在官府报备，记录在案。
私铸兵器，乃是重罪。
指虎这等奇门兵器，虽非刀剑，但其杀伤力不容小觑，公然找铁匠打造，风险不小。
思来想去，林青记起了父亲林庆曾偶然提起过的一处地方。
位于清平县城外西南二十多里，一片废弃砖窑地底下的黑市。
父亲当年行医采药，三教九流皆有接触，曾因一味稀有药材去过一次。
回来后便严令林青不得靠近，只粗略提过进入的方法和信物。
如今，他自己已经是一重关修为，算是有了一定的实力，决定去探一探。

他凭借记忆，画出了指虎的详细结构图，并且在尖端放置一根利刃，要求用精铁锻造，边缘需打磨锋利。
他将这一自己稍微改造后的武器，命名为麒麟刺。
翌日，他向姐姐说自己出趟远门，而后早早出门。
出了城后，他见到不少身穿锦袍，骑着高头大马的公子小姐，在随从簇拥下远去。
路上，还可见到不少流民，在路上搭起窝棚，带着子女生火煮粥。
只不过那锅里的粥，只能见着清水和一些野菜，便是米粒都很少。
这世道，哪里都不太平，一旦有什么灾难，大部分人都只能被迫背井离乡。
林青在一处隐蔽的丛林中，更换行头。
以黑布蒙脸，换了一身略显破旧的单衣。
他一路小心谨慎，避开官道。
路上也有一些衣衫褴褛的行人，大都以警惕的目光看人。
林青花费近一个时辰后，按照父亲模糊的描述，找到了那片荒草丛生，窑洞坍塌的废弃砖窑。
路上，明显多了不少蒙脸人，行色匆匆，大多身上都挎着刀剑，互相提防警惕。
顺着人群来往的方向，林青来到其中一座看似完全塌陷的窑洞侧面。
他拨开茂密的藤蔓，里面赫然是一条宽敞的土路，正通往地下。
林青小心前行，不少人擦肩而过，彼此也并不说话。
很快，一个依靠人工开凿而成的地下窑洞呈现在眼前。
窑洞面积很大，约莫数千平方米。
里面空间内灯火通明，人影绰绰，却并不喧闹。
路口一个守门汉子，长得人高马大，伸手将他拦下。

“进入黑市，需缴纳一百文入市钱。”
“晓得。”
林青数出一百文钱递过去。

Lin Qing sighed and did not continue to ask about the details of the war. He just said to Zhang Shun: "Brother Shunzi, please help me pay attention. If there is anything about the front line. Especially the news from Youzhou, whether good or bad, please let me know."
Zhang Shun patted his shoulder and responded solemnly: "Don't worry, Junior Brother Lin, I will tell you the news as soon as possible."
After entering the realm of skin refining, Iron Thread Fist has also reached perfection.
Lin Qing can clearly feel the growth of his own strength.
The energy and blood are full, the skin is tough, and the strength between the fists and feet is far beyond what it used to be.
However, after competing with his senior brothers in the martial arts gym and experiencing the thrill of the night at the pier.
There was always one thought in his mind.
After all, boxing and kicking routines are just skills on the surface.
Once someone figures out the route, or encounters a desperado armed with a sharp knife, he will inevitably suffer a loss.
He remembered a common melee weapon among the fighting weapons in his previous life - the finger tiger.
This object has a simple structure, but it can greatly enhance the destructive power of boxing. It is especially suitable for fierce and violent boxing techniques such as wire boxing. It is also inconspicuous when worn on the hand, and can have unexpected effects at critical moments.
But in this Dashun Dynasty, any blacksmith shop that forged swords and other standard weapons had to be reported to the government and recorded.
Privately forging weapons is a serious crime.
Although strange weapons such as the Zhihu are not swords, their lethality cannot be underestimated. It is risky to openly ask a blacksmith to make them.
After thinking about it, Lin Qing remembered a place that her father Lin Qing once accidentally mentioned.
Located more than 20 miles southwest of Qingping County, there is a black market under an abandoned brick kiln.
My father used to practice medicine and collect herbs, and had contact with all three religions. He once went there because he was looking for rare medicinal materials.
After returning, he strictly ordered Lin Qing not to come near, and only briefly mentioned the method of entry and tokens.
Now, he himself has reached the first level of cultivation and has a certain strength, so he decided to explore it.
Based on his memory, he drew a detailed structural diagram of the finger tiger, and placed a sharp blade at the tip, which was required to be forged from fine iron and the edge polished to a sharp edge.
He named this slightly modified weapon Qilin Thorn.
The next day, he told his sister that he was going on a long trip, and then went out early.
After leaving the city, he saw many young ladies wearing brocade robes and riding tall horses, riding away surrounded by their entourage.
On the road, you can still see many refugees, setting up shacks on the road and lighting fires with their children to cook porridge.
But the porridge in the pot only contained water and some wild vegetables, and there were very few rice grains.
Nothing is peaceful in this world. Once there is any disaster, most people will be forced to leave their homes.
Lin Qing was changing her outfit in a hidden jungle.
He covered his face with a black cloth and changed into a pair of slightly worn single clothes.
He was cautious all the way and avoided official roads.
There were also some ragged pedestrians on the road, and most of them looked at people with wary eyes.
After spending nearly an hour, Lin Qing found the abandoned brick kiln that was overgrown with grass and collapsed according to his father's vague description.
On the road, there were obviously many more people with masked faces, walking in a hurry, most of them had swords on their bodies, and they were wary of each other.
Following the direction of the crowd, Lin Qing came to the side of one of the cave dwellings that seemed to have completely collapsed.
He pushed aside the dense vines, and there was a spacious dirt road leading underground.
Lin Qing moved forward cautiously, and many people passed by without speaking to each other.
Soon, an underground cave dwelling dug manually appeared in front of us.
The cave dwelling area is very large, about thousands of square meters.
The space inside was brightly lit and there were many people, but it was not noisy.
A tall gatekeeper stood at the intersection and stopped him with his hand.
"To enter the black market, you need to pay one hundred coins to enter the market."
"I know."
Lin Qing counted out a hundred coins and handed it over.
